abstract: Maintains remote telemetry gateway records and substation optical network availability logs
system_message:
You are the SCADA communications specialist (TEL), responsible for maintaining remote telemetry gateway records and substation optical network availability logs across regional transmission network facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Substation network ping latency（LATEN）
information_points.content:
TEL-LATEN-Y4E：At Grand River Hydroelectric Generating Station, the primary telecontrol SCADA optical channel latency averages an 8 ms round-trip delay between regional dispatch and facility substation gateways.
TEL-LATEN-R4E：At Thorold Aeroderivative Peaking Facility, the primary telecontrol SCADA optical channel latency averages a 4 ms round-trip delay between regional dispatch and facility substation gateways.
TEL-LATEN-A7V：At Clearview Battery Energy Storage Complex, the primary telecontrol SCADA optical channel latency averages a 12 ms round-trip delay between regional dispatch and facility substation gateways.

information_points.title: Maintains remote telemetry gateway records and substation optical network availability logs（COMM）
information_points.content:
TEL-COMM-TAR：For Thorold Aeroderivative Peaking Facility, the twelve-month rolling SCADA telemetry link availability is recorded at 97% of operational hours with uninterrupted real-time telemetry streaming to regional dispatch.
TEL-COMM-T3Y：For Grand River Hydroelectric Generating Station, the twelve-month rolling SCADA telemetry link availability stands at 94%, reflecting the percentage of operational hours with uninterrupted real-time telemetry streaming to regional dispatch.
TEL-COMM-N25：For Clearview Battery Energy Storage Complex, the twelve-month rolling SCADA telemetry link availability reaches 99% of operational hours with uninterrupted real-time telemetry streaming to regional dispatch.
